subject.title: [security] Idle Admin Bridge Sockets Are Not Reconciled on Scheduled Admin Grant Rotation

question: Should direct alarm and Node pg-boss reconciliation close idle admin-authorized bridge/control sockets after admin grant rotation, or should the documented scheduled reconciliation contract be narrowed to the version-stamped Cloudflare cron/request path?
rationale: The source evidence shows a real difference between version-stamped scheduled requests and direct alarm jobs, but the choice changes security-boundary fail-closed behavior and the public revocation contract.

options.title: Add an alarm-time sweep
options.body: Invoke a shared admin-grant reconciliation helper from direct alarm/pg-boss maintenance so idle admin sockets close even without a version-stamped request.

options.title: Narrow the documentation
options.body: Document that idle active sockets are proactively closed by version-stamped requests such as Cloudflare cron, while direct alarms only handle lifecycle maintenance.

options.title: Split Cloudflare and Node behavior
options.body: Keep Cloudflare cron as-is and add a Node-specific version-stamped reconciliation job if maintainers do not want direct `alarm()` to inspect bridge grants.

recommendation.title: Add an alarm-time sweep
recommendation.body: Invoke a shared admin-grant reconciliation helper from direct alarm/pg-boss maintenance so idle admin sockets close even without a version-stamped request.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history across the admin grant, bridge revocation, and Node alarm paths involved in the decision.
